newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia's Ventspils repairs railway supply lines.
newsitem.headline: Latvia's Ventspils repairs railway supply lines.

text.p: Latvia's Ventspils Nafta oil terminal, one of the main outlets of Russian oil products, said on Tuesday that it was closing two of its four railway supply lines until August 28 for repairs.
The railway line, consisting of two platforms of two lines each, is used for delivering diesel.
"The annual repair work of the railway platform is coordinated with Ventspils Nafta's Russian clients and buyers in the West," the company said in a statement.
A spokesman said that one railway platform would remain open during the repairs.
He said that there would be no reduction in volumes through the railway terminal.
